systems.system: SPAAT ICT and solar equipment for police legal departments
systems.country_label: Supporting Police Accountability and Transformation Project (SPAAT)
systems.platform: 2.5kVa inverter systems with batteries and solar panels, 3-in-1 desktop computers, multifunction printers
systems.owner: Nigeria Police Force Legal Directorate; supplied by UNDP with German federal funding, with the Global Security Sector Foundation and the CLEEN Foundation
systems.tiers: Force Headquarters Legal Directorate, Abuja, and the legal departments of 15 state commands (Enugu, Abia, Akwa Ibom, Anambra, Edo, FCT, Imo, Kaduna, Kano, Lagos, Plateau, Oyo, Rivers, Kwara, Borno); handover captioned May 2025; over 80 police legal officers

note: Hardware and power for the legal departments of the headquarters and 15 state commands: enabling class. The text speaks of access to digital case management but names no system and describes no record made at a station, so no fact.
